title: Shadowed-module divergence ledger
sources: UpstreamDrift divergence inventory v1 (UpstreamDrift#9432, comment on Tools#4915)

rulings.tools-canonical: Tools is the source; UD consumes (vendor pin / wheel). Tools-only PRs allowed.
rulings.ud-canonical: UD is the source; Tools must not shadow it.
rulings.split: Both halves are intentionally different estimands/artifacts; a change to either side is paired cross-repo work.
rulings.deferred: Owner ruling pending on the seam epic; until ruled, a Tools change needs a paired UD PR (UD-PAIR: D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift#N).

gate.rule: A PR touching a ledgered tools_path must carry 'UD-PAIR: D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift#N' in its body unless the row's ruling is tools-canonical or its status is ud-copy-deleted.

D30 legacy half is the mirror image: UpstreamDrift's corpus.py must gain the manifest gate (five corpora rate_of_closure refuses, UD loads silently); test_corpus_drift.py's five D30 cases pin its permissiveness. Paired PR. D28 narrows, D29/D31 unchanged (UD capabilities carried over verbatim).

analyze_dispersion (D6-D9, disjoint result surface) and analyze_session_trend (same name, different estimand) stay as the web-twinned application layer; the canonical inferential layer is Tools launch_monitor per ADR-0046 (1.18.114 docstring alignment).
